fields.name: MoveSpeed
fields.doc: Movement speed in metres per second.

fields.name: Acceleration
fields.doc: How hard the agent accelerates toward its speed.

fields.name: IdleClip
fields.doc: Animation clip played while standing still.

fields.name: WalkClip
fields.doc: Animation clip played while moving.

fields.name: StartEvent
fields.doc: Event posted for this emitter.

fields.name: Is3D
fields.doc: Off makes it 2D: positioned for convenience, heard at full level everywhere.

fields.name: AttenuationScale
fields.doc: Scales the sound's authored falloff; 1 is the authored distance.

fields.name: Colliders
fields.doc: Collision shapes, edited with the host's own handles.

fields.name: DisplayName
fields.doc: Name shown to the player when this can be interacted with.

fields.name: Kind
fields.doc: Free-form label the runtime groups by, e.g. Prop, Character, Door.

fields.name: IsActive
fields.doc: Spawn this entity when the level loads.

fields.name: InitialAnimation
fields.doc: Animation clip to start on spawn; empty for none.

fields.name: Prefab
fields.doc: Source asset this entity was placed from.

fields.name: DisplayName
fields.doc: Name shown in tools; defaults to the node's own name.

fields.name: SpawnPhase
fields.doc: When in the load sequence this entity appears.

fields.name: Kind
fields.doc: Sprite = camera-facing flipbook quads; Voxel = solid tinted cubes.

fields.name: Seed
fields.doc: Same seed, same particle stream in every host.

fields.name: Sheet
fields.doc: Flipbook spritesheet for the particles.

fields.name: Mesh
fields.doc: The source GLB this entity renders.

fields.name: MeshNode
fields.doc: Optional node inside the GLB; empty means its whole default scene.

fields.name: Materials
fields.doc: Material overrides, one per GLB primitive. Derived from the mesh at export.

fields.name: BodyType
fields.doc: Static bodies never move; dynamic ones are simulated.

fields.name: Mass
fields.doc: Mass in kilograms. Ignored for static bodies.

fields.name: LinearDamping
fields.doc: Linear velocity bleed-off per second.

fields.name: Restitution
fields.doc: Bounciness: 0 absorbs the impact, 1 returns it.

fields.name: Friction
fields.doc: Surface friction: 0 is ice, 1 is grippy.

fields.name: Layer
fields.doc: Collision layer index. Prefer LayerName where the project defines one.

fields.name: LayerName
fields.doc: Named collision layer, resolved against the project's layer contract.
